note: Ratio and group size limits for home based child care. Only the states Tally has been checked against are listed. Adding a state means adding its table here, not changing agent code.

TX.name: Texas
TX.source: Texas Health and Human Services, Minimum Standards for Child Care Homes.

registered.label: Registered child care home
registered.note: Up to six children under 14, plus up to six more school age children, with limits on how many are under two.

licensed.label: Licensed child care home
licensed.note: Up to 12 children, with a second caregiver required above certain counts.
